messages:
clara: Quick sync — finalizing the v1 -> v2 migration guide and deprecation flow. I opened PR 2222 with the banner text, redirect map template, and a migration QA checklist. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2222 :wave:

noah: Link received. Two quick asks before we merge: (1) include the exact SDK error message so support can grep, (2) add a concise embed fallback pattern for teams that can't retrain vectors immediately.

ida: For (1) please include examples across languages (JS/py/go/ruby) with the exception class/string so folks can search logs. For (2) prefer showing a deterministic pad helper instead of an ad-hoc example.

clara: Agreed. Draft error strings I plan to add: "Error: 410 DeprecatedEndpoint: endpoint removed, upgrade to client v2" and the JS shape comment: `// e.code === 410 && e.type === 'DeprecatedEndpoint'`.

noah: For the embed fallback, here's a compact pad helper we can include in the guide. Keep it intentionally tiny so it's copy-paste friendly.

```
# python pad helper
def pad(vec, target=1536):
    if len(vec) >= target:
        return vec[:target]
    return vec + [0.0] * (target - len(vec))

# usage: v = api.embed(model='embed-legacy', input=t); v = pad(v)
```

ida: Add a short note: "Normalization/scale may differ between models; downstream scoring should re-normalize after padding." Also include a one-line JS equivalent.

noah: JS snippet:

```
// js pad helper
function pad(vec, target = 1536) {
  if (vec.length >= target) return vec.slice(0, target)
  return vec.concat(Array(target - vec.length).fill(0.0))
}
```

platform-bot: Ops checklist: prefer path-level 301s for CDN caching. Canary plan requested: 48h @5% then 24h @50% before full redirect. Include rollback flag in the redirect map.

clara: Timeline looks good. Legal asked for 21-day soft notice; ops will run the canary after merge. I'll add the rollout calendar to the playbook and a checkbox to notify AEs for Dedicated/Private customers.

ida: Also include a tiny SDK migration note: header-based routing example for proxies: `X-Redwood-Client: v2`. That helps customers using custom routing.

noah: Let's include the exact Go and Ruby error-handling examples too (1-2 lines each) so support can grep quickly.

```
// go
if err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "DeprecatedEndpoint") {
  // upgrade guidance
}

# ruby
begin
  client.call(...)
rescue Redwood::DeprecatedEndpointError => e
  puts e.message
end
```

docs-bot: Please add labels `deprecation`, `migration`, `needs-smoke`. CI will run snippet lint, example tests, and a docs smoke render on push. :robot_face:

clara: I'll update PR 2222 with: (a) language-specific error examples, (b) pad helpers, (c) rollout checklist + rollback flag, (d) AE contact reminder for non-hosted deployments, and (e) a short FAQ blurb on billing during soft banners. Target merge: Friday AM.

ida: I'll review once pushed. If anyone can volunteer to write the short support blurb and the announcement copy post-merge, reply here.

noah: I can write the support blurb and a sample search query for support ("DeprecatedEndpoint" OR "410 DeprecatedEndpoint").

clara: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll push updates and ping for final review. :thumbsup:
